{{Quote|Vader! Darth Vader! He's alone! We got a bunch of freelancers trying to take him down!|A bounty hunter|<ref name="Empire 4">[[Empire 4|''Empire'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Ambush on Dargulli''' was an attack on [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] which happened at the same time of the [[Anti-Sith conspiracy]] of [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|He's alone.''"<br />"''I've never heard of him going out alone...''"<br />"''No one's ever had a chance like this.|Three freelancers|<ref name="Empire: Betrayal 3" />}}
Vader had been lured to [[Dargulli/Legends|Dargulli]] by rumors of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] operating on the planet. Leaving the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Mathayus]]'' in orbit, Vader landed on the planet alone with his [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]].

Progressing in the city where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was hiding, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] met local freelancers announced them he was only there to find the Jedi. However he was attacked and later ambushed by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] bent on making a name for themselves. Among these ones, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who was in a nearby [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]], decided to help Vader instead. With the aid of Fett, Vader eliminated all of his attackers. The bounty hunter advised him afterwards to leave the city quickly before another attack but they were approached by the cause of the rumors, a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] [[Dargulli Dark Jedi|practitioner]] who sought to become Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]]. She offered Vader to help him overthrow the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] but the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] refused, killing her with his [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
